Markets.title: Silver rebounds from correction: Can the recovery gain momentum?
Markets.summary: Silver has rebounded from its recent correction, driven by gold's rally, a weaker US dollar, and rising industrial demand. Although long-term support comes from tight supply and green technologies, shifting monetary policy and high volatility may limit short-term gains.

Markets.title: Bitcoin falls below $78,000 as crypto market faces correction after Warsh’s Jackson Hole comments
Markets.summary: Bitcoin fell below $78,000 and Ethereum extended losses as the cryptocurrency market corrected following Kevin Warsh's hawkish comments on inflation and U.S. monetary policy. Elevated leverage, liquidations, and crypto ETF inflows influenced the broader market alongside these declines.

Markets.title: Reliance Jio IPO: 7 risk factors investors should know as firm gets Sebi nod for Rs 37,000-crore issue
Markets.summary: Reliance Jio has received market regulator Sebi's approval for its massive Rs 37,700-crore initial public offering. However, the company's draft papers warn investors of several key risks, including intense market competition, high capital expenditure, and spectrum challenges.

Markets.title: Vedanta, Wipro among 10 stocks that saw biggest jump in retail holders in Q1. See full list
Markets.summary: Vedanta, Wipro, and Bajaj Auto experienced the largest increases in retail shareholders during Q1FY27. These companies were among ten major stocks that attracted strong retail investor participation in the first quarter.

Markets.title: We imported the auction, but we left out the brakes
Markets.summary: India's Closing Auction Session suffers from weak safeguards because it allows order cancellations until the auction ends. This vulnerability to market manipulation highlights the urgent need for stronger controls and better protection around settlement prices.

Markets.title: US Fed rate hike bets soar to 57% from 30% after Warsh's speech. What are Goldman Sachs and others saying?
Markets.summary: Traders increased the probability of a September US interest rate hike from 30% to 57% following a speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. However, Goldman Sachs expects rates to remain unchanged unless hotter-than-expected inflation data alters the outlook.

Geo-Political.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
Geo-Political.summary: Dramatic footage of deadly flash flooding in Tibet is being censored and hidden from the public in China. Consequently, very little information is currently known about the victims of the disaster.

Geo-Political.title: At least 27 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv warehouse
Geo-Political.summary: A missile strike on a Kyiv warehouse caused a series of explosions, killing at least 27 people and forcing hundreds to evacuate. Authorities are investigating whether ammunition was stored at the location.

Geo-Political.title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced a historic agreement giving the United States control over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil. Venezuelan interim president Delcy Rodriguez stated that this unusual pact will help revive her nation's struggling economy.

Geo-Political.title: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
Geo-Political.summary: The former landlady of two al-Qaeda 9/11 hijackers has spoken publicly to the BBC for the first time. She revealed details regarding their connections to an alleged Saudi spy.

Geo-Political.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
Geo-Political.summary: Norway is mourning the death of King Harald as citizens and dignitaries gather outside the palace. His son has succeeded him to the throne as King Haakon VIII and adopted the family motto "all for Norway."

Geo-Political.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
Geo-Political.summary: British citizen and right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos was detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Yiannopoulos, who lives and works in the United States, has previously expressed support for both President Trump and ICE agents.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves hit record high on RBI steps to attract US dollars
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves reached a record high due to Reserve Bank of India measures aimed at attracting US dollars. This increase provides the RBI with more financial strength to support the rupee, which continues to be one of Asia's weakest currencies.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth narrows to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in July compared to 8.8% in June. Despite this moderation and a decline in mining, strong performance in the manufacturing and capital goods sectors kept overall growth robust.

Data & Insights.title: Algeria becomes India's 3rd-largest source of LPG in August amid supply crunch
Data & Insights.summary: In August, Algeria exported 110,711 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to India, accounting for roughly a tenth of India's total imports of 1.08 million tonnes. This surge in shipments amid a supply crunch made Algeria India's third-largest source of LPG for the month.

Data & Insights.title: Not just the farmer, PSBs may soon fund entire farm value chains
Data & Insights.summary: The government has proposed that public sector banks shift from lending to individual farmers to funding entire agricultural value chains. This cluster-based plan will connect farmers and FPOs with processors, storage, and logistics businesses based on key district products.

Data & Insights.title: India, Canada seek to deepen economic cooperation beyond trade through investment, finance and capital markets
Data & Insights.summary: At their inaugural Economic and Financial Dialogue, Indian and Canadian finance ministers discussed ways to deepen economic cooperation beyond traditional trade. Their talks focused on domestic macroeconomic stability, financial-sector integration, and multilateral cooperation on critical minerals.

Data & Insights.title: Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech: 5 key things markets expect to hear from new Fed chief on 28 August
Data & Insights.summary: Markets are awaiting Kevin Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole speech for insights on his approach to monetary policy and underlying inflation. While his past comments suggest a cautious stance on rate hikes, investors remain uncertain about the specific indicators he will use to measure inflation.

India.title: 3 Delhi BJP MPs Visit Sajjan Kumar's House. Then Party Chief's Big Action
India.summary: Three Delhi BJP MPs visited the home of Sajjan Kumar, who died this month while serving a life sentence for his role in the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. Following the visit, the party chief took unspecified disciplinary action.

India.title: 2 Killed In Violent Clash Over Neem Tree Beside House In Telangana
India.summary: Two people were killed in a violent clash in Telangana's Suryapet district. The violence erupted from a long-standing property dispute over a neem tree located beside a house.

India.title: 'Gorilla Campaign' At Panjab University As Monkey Menace Becomes Poll Issue
India.summary: Students at Panjab University launched a "gorilla campaign" to highlight the growing problem of monkeys on campus. The issue has become a key topic in student elections.

India.title: Bihar To Replace 'Fail' With 'Eligible For Skills' On Class 10, 12 Marksheets
India.summary: Bihar is replacing the term "fail" with "eligible for skills" on Class 10 and 12 marksheets. The state education minister stated that low exam scores do not reflect a child's full potential.

India.title: "There's Pressure": Congress vs BJP As Penguin India Drops Sonia Gandhi's Memoir
